L27n2311.name: Church name fragments
L27n2311.description: Fires on the piece of a capitalized name or term split across tokens, in church and memorial text: the '.' after 'St', 'Rem' in 'Remembrance', 'Cath' in 'Cathedrals'. Pushes the model toward 'test'/'Test' tokens.

L27n283.name: Token before a number
L27n283.description: Fires on the space or token right before a figure in news and statistics text ('in 2020', 'over 21 million', 'about 5%'), where a digit is expected next. Pushes the model toward digit tokens.

L27n211.name: Split-word opener before suffix
L27n211.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into tokens when a suffix piece follows (sar|comas, sk|it, Sw|immers, der|mis, Comp|ounds). Pushes the model toward 'im'/'em' word pieces.

L27n343.name: Mid-name proper-noun pieces
L27n343.description: Strongly negative on the second or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens (Suk|hpur, Mp|um|alanga, Ban Ki|-moon, Hos|ack, JA|XA). Pushes the model toward capital 'D' tokens.

L27n215.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n215.description: Strongly negative on a non-initial piece of a capitalized name or unusual word split into tokens (Ik|ht|iyar, Gu|ising, Zam|be|zi, Mar|akes, PAR|RISE). Pushes the model toward 'isis'/'ilia' pieces.

L27n243.name: Word pieces before suffixes
L27n243.description: Strongly negative on a word-internal piece, often the one before a suffix completes it (exh|ales, th|robbed, Schenck|ensch, bb|les, sar|com|as). Pushes the model toward '-ases', '-asis' and '-ists' suffix pieces.

L27n16.name: Determiner before noun
L27n16.description: Negative on determiners and quantifiers ('the', 'our', 'every', 'each', 'several', 'without') right before the noun they introduce. Pushes the model toward abstract nouns like Address, Performance and Properties.

L27n2321.name: qu- and name openers
L27n2321.description: Fires on the 'qu' piece or first piece of a word or name split into tokens (qu|inoa, qu|artile, qu|asar, Gu|imarães, Ja|én, Zach). Pushes the model toward 'article'/'Article' tokens.

L27n521.name: Split-word first fragments
L27n521.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, especially 'sl', 'st', 'Ad', 'inter' and 'br' (sl|ant, st|ings, Ad|oration, inter|com, br|ussels). Pushes the model toward 'image'/'message' tokens.

L27n1186.name: re- and op- fragments
L27n1186.description: Fires on a 're' or 'op' fragment inside a split word (well-re|searched, re|claims, vas|op|ressin, Neo|op|latonic, Ship|re|cks). Pushes the model toward 'product'/'products' tokens.

L27n716.name: Word before past participle
L27n716.description: Negative on the word right before a past participle: 'have/has' after a subject, 'get' before an adjective, relative 'that/which'. Pushes the model toward 'described', 'selected', 'identified' and 'stated'.

L27n3028.name: Proper-name first pieces
L27n3028.description: Negative on the first or middle piece of a capitalized proper name (Laf|itte, Rams|es, Los| Alamos, Gh|af, Prof. S|ive). Pushes the model toward 'experiment' tokens.

L27n989.name: Split-word fragments, 'list'
L27n989.description: Fires on mid-word pieces that open a split word (puzz|ling, padd|ler, add|ling, Kaz|aa). Pushes the model toward 'list'/'lists' tokens.

L27n765.name: ALL-CAPS word pieces
L27n765.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (MESSE|NG|ER, CAL|AB|ASAS, LIFE|CY|CLE, E|LECT|RIC, EXT. slugline). Pushes the model toward capital 'R' tokens.

L27n2762.name: Contr- and split-word openers
L27n2762.description: Fires on pieces of words split into tokens, such as 'contr' (contr|ived, contr|arious), 'd' (d|ouches) and 'Wu|X|ing', plus 'the' before body or nature nouns. Pushes the model toward 'inner'/'inside' tokens.

L27n1304.name: con/pres word openers
L27n1304.description: Fires on a word-opening fragment split into tokens, especially 'con', 'cons', 'pres', 'res' and 'uncon' (pres|umably, con|scription, uncon|sciously). Pushes the model toward 'sum' pieces (consum-, presum-).

L27n3042.name: Word-initial f fragment
L27n3042.description: Fires on a lone 'f' or 'Inf' that opens a word split into tokens (f|ared, f|angs, f|athom, Inf|initives, f|ashions). Pushes the model toward 'get'/'gets'/'got' tokens.

L27n820.name: Proper-name opening fragments
L27n820.description: Negative on the first piece of a proper name or place split into tokens (St|amps, Sar|acen, Be|cciu, Pis|ano, Wol|longong, Far|ah). Pushes the model toward 'name'/'names' tokens.

L27n1442.name: Diacritic-adjacent word pieces
L27n1442.description: Fires on a mid-word piece right after an odd symbol or diacritic (´ in author names, ʻ in Hawaiʻi, ‘ in ‘Abdu’l-Bahá). Pushes weakly toward accented letters like ð, Þ, ú and é.

L27n1811.name: Initial capital of names
L27n1811.description: Negative on a lone capital letter that starts a proper name or acronym (G|ogh, G|OCI, G|ao, J|AXA, E|uthanasia, D|nevnik). Pushes the model toward closing '}' brace tokens.

L27n2115.name: Proper-name fragment starts
L27n2115.description: The first subword piece of a capitalised surname or first name, right after a person's name or title, e.g. 'Gr' in Grisons, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'Be' in Becciu, 'Gre' in Straume, 'Te' in Teesside. Pushes toward 'decision' tokens.

L27n1250.name: Split-word fragment continuations
L27n1250.description: Short pieces that complete a split word, e.g. '-t' in 'twin-tail' and 'Kaga Sho-taro', 'orth' in 'orthotic', 'reint' in 'reintroduced', 'int' in 'high-intensity', 'ict' in 'Wydawnictwo', plus the short word right after such a piece ('it' in 'toll it takes', 'to' in 'wanted to take'). Pushes toward 'take'.

L27n201.name: Verb start after to/modal
L27n201.description: The first piece of a bare verb right after 'to', 'can', 'may' or 'will', e.g. 're' in 'may re-occur', 'under' in 'can underpin', 'mass' in 'mass produce', 'super' in 'will supercede', 'over' in 'over-hype', 'double' in 'can double-click'. When pushed negative it promotes bare verbs such as 'do', 'consider', 'think'.

L27n1445.name: Mid-word fragments (-al, Sp)
L27n1445.description: Word-internal pieces of a split word, often a hyphenated or very short piece such as '-al' in 'Latin-alphabet', '-l' in 'green-lipped', 'Sp' in 'Sp-ending', 'exc' in 'exc-ised', 'Al' in 'Slavic-Albanian'. When pushed negative it promotes 'problem'.

L27n1096.name: Connectives in formal prose
L27n1096.description: Function words in the middle of a formal or expository clause, e.g. 'and' in 'problems with concept and perform', 'to' in 'does not come to', 'has' in 'global warming has', 'often' in 'Nature-themed writing often', 'most' in 'the most suitable'. When pushed negative it promotes punctuation (comma, double quote, period).

L27n740.name: Single-letter word-start pieces
L27n740.description: The first short fragment of a split word or name, often one letter or a consonant cluster, e.g. 'j' in 'juts' and 'July', 'V' in 'Vitiligo', 'v' in 'vaccine', 'tet' in 'tetraplegia', 'ple' in 'pleural', 'cov' in 'covariant', 'Cl' in 'Clifton'. Pushes toward capital-letter tokens 'A', 'C', 'S', 'B'.

L27n625.name: b-initial word starts
L27n625.description: The 'b', 'br' or 'Bl' token that opens a word, mostly a split or name-like word: 'b' in 'bumblebee', 'bre' in 'breeder', 'b' in 'basking shark', 'b' in 'bermudagrass', 'Bl' in 'Blasco', 'B' in 'Biodiversity', 'seab' in 'seabirds'. Pushes toward 'bi' and 'bio' tokens.

L27n1957.name: Name and word fragments
L27n1957.description: Pieces that open a name or continue a split word: 'Cle' in 'Cleve', 'Has' in 'Hasmon', 'ys' in 'Gettysburg', 'yt' in 'fairytale', 'Mel' in 'Melons', 'ipation' in 'Emancipation', 'sent' in 'sisters sent'. Pushes toward 'word' and 'words'.

L27n2410.name: Medical word-start fragments
L27n2410.description: The first piece of a split medical or Latinate term: 'ple' in 'pleural' and 'pleura', 'par' in 'paraplegia' and 'parasympathetic', 'pred' in 'prediabetes', 'con' in 'convection' and 'contractile', 'H' in 'Hindus' and 'Harmful', 'per' in 'pernicious'. Pushes toward 'ways' and 'way'.

L27n963.name: Compound-word start fragments
L27n963.description: The first piece of a split or compound word, often a capital or prefix chunk: 'G' in 'Vilna Ghetto', 'C' in 'CARRY', 'iber' in 'Beriberi', 'rec' in 'recollect', 'os' in 'cynosure', 'hydro' in 'hydroponic', '-st' in 'pre-stressed'. Pushes toward 'change'.

L27n2375.name: Capitalised name starts
L27n2375.description: Capital or stem fragments that open a name or code, e.g. 'Ch' in 'Chao Phraya', 'Ste' in 'Stejskal' and 'Steffen', 'AL' in a UK postcode, 'Carm' in 'Carmarthen', 'Black' in 'Blackland Prairies'. Pushes toward digit tokens '6', '2', '3'.

L27n530.name: Long-word stem fragments
L27n530.description: A stem piece that begins a longer word, e.g. 'contr' in 'contrarious', 'decre' in 'decrees', 'prote' in 'protease', 'pur' in 'purports', 'disc' in 'discursive', 'Sw' in 'Swastika', 'gl' in 'glia'. Pushes toward digit tokens '7', '3', '4'.

L27n2497.name: Short word-start pieces
L27n2497.description: A short first piece of a word, mostly 't' in 'tamed', 'tummy' and 'tiger', plus 'par' in 'parmesan', 'sm' in 'smacking', 'Th' in 'Thrace' and 'Bl' in 'Blaeu'. Pushes toward 'great'.

L27n1444.name: Place/people name fragments
L27n1444.description: Opening fragments of proper nouns, e.g. 'Par' in 'Parthenon', 'Paraguay' and 'Pariah', 'Tar' in 'Tarquin', 'em' in 'empire', 'im' in 'Imams', 'Sc' in 'Scelzo'. Pushes toward 'example'.

L27n2160.name: Surname fragment starts
L27n2160.description: The first fragment of a surname or a split technical word: 'lig' in 'Hotamisligil', 'fres' in 'frescoes', 'f' in 'flossing', 'Borg' in 'Borglum', 'pp' in 'Pappa'. Pushes toward 'face' and 'faces'.

L27n1507.name: Non-ASCII symbols and letters
L27n1507.description: Non-ASCII or symbolic characters on their own: the ohm sign in '200 Ω resistor', Cyrillic 'С' and 'п', Arabic letters, 'õ', and foreign name pieces such as 'Los', 'UL', 'FA'. Pushes toward accented Latin capitals 'Å', 'À', 'Î', 'Ô'.

L27n601.name: Split-word second pieces
L27n601.description: The second piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'b' in 'Middles|brough', 'And' in 'Andalus', 'agr' in 'bermudagrass', 'wh' in 'whorls' and 'whiten', 'ost' in 'somat|ostatin', 'Imm' in 'Immune Deficiency', '-H' in 'McGraw-Hill'. Pushes toward 'pi', 'k', 'ph', 'ch'.

L27n11.name: 'is' after named subject
L27n11.description: The copula 'is' or 'was' right after a named subject at the start of a chat answer, e.g. 'Flamenco is', 'The Taj Mahal is', 'The Egyptian Book of the Dead was', 'Nostalgia is'. Pushes toward code-like capital tokens 'AK', 'AB', 'DP'.

L27n669.name: Dot in initialisms, URLs
L27n669.description: The period glued to a capital letter inside an initialism, e.g. '.S' in 'U.S.', '.J' in 'J.J.', '.P' in 'U.P.', '.C' in 'D.C.', plus 'www' in web addresses. Pushes toward a dot before a code method name such as '.SetValue' and '.ToString'.

L27n524.name: Capitalised compound-term fragments
L27n524.description: Uppercase or mid-term pieces of a capitalised name or heading: 'NG' in 'MESSENGER', 'Re' in 'Reusable', 'Object' in 'Object Management Group', 'Product' before 'Owner', 'Service' in 'Service Oriented', 'Y' in 'VU STUDY GROUPS'. Pushes toward 'H'.

L27n1996.name: Split name start, extra
L27n1996.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word or name split into tokens, on the token before its unfinished end (Hash|em, Sp|icy, Tit|us, Stan|wick, Al|mohad); pushes toward 'extra' and 'additional'.

L27n190.name: Mid-word fragment, o-syllables
L27n190.description: Strongly negative on the middle or last piece of a long word cut into 3+ tokens (cant|al|oupe, carb|ap|enems, under|p|innings, COR|RESP|ONDENCE, per|oxide); pushes toward short fragments like ovo, olo, obo, ro.

L27n3022.name: Compound piece, network
L27n3022.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a split name or term (Sh|one, Rush|d, Ph|raya, Ravish|ankar, re|connection) and on 'Action' in 'Basel Action Network'; pushes toward 'network'.

L27n1629.name: Name fragment, child
L27n1629.description: Strongly negative on split proper-name pieces (Roth|amsted, Ker|et, Hos|feld, Amp|etro) and on 'Inf|ants'; pushes toward 'child' and 'children'.

L27n1341.name: Name start, OR operator
L27n1341.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a split name or term (Fr|isia, Fr|anks, S|andor, Schw|ann, Verd|igris, R|IPv1, C|olds) and on 'se' in seborrhea; pushes toward '||' and '&&'.

L27n673.name: Long-word prefix, re
L27n673.description: Strongly negative on the prefix or middle piece of a long technical word (retro|viral, Prot|olaurasia, ant|iretrovirals, mult|ilayer, corticotrop|in) and on the first digit of '400°F'; pushes toward 're' fragments.

L27n2163.name: Word start, dev
L27n2163.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, in names and Sanskrit (cre|vice, Kh|ulaifi, D|harma, Tx|tr, Buddh|ists, ṛ|daya); pushes toward 'dev' and 'device'.

L27n1105.name: Name start, year
L27n1105.description: Fires on the first piece of a split name (Pic|uda, Tong|a, Har|penden, Dok|sanaltı) and on 'light' before 'years' or 'trucks'; pushes toward 'year'.

L27n2260.name: 'st' word start, style
L27n2260.description: Fires on a word-initial 'st' or 'St' piece cut from its word (st|uffs, St|aying, st|umped, -st|udies, St|icherus), often right after a hyphen; pushes toward 'style'.

L27n2683.name: Split word piece, demand
L27n2683.description: Strongly negative on the middle piece of a compound or split word (semi-aut|onomous, bona f|ide, Ikht|iyar, Rab|as, T|isha); pushes toward 'demand' and 'req'.

L27n1648.name: Word start, raise
L27n1648.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (L|ilies, M|awr, Cor|rimal, fl|aring, cl|ippings, cam|otes), usually a name or noun; pushes toward 'raise' and 'raised'.

L27n2584.name: 'se' word start, curve
L27n2584.description: Fires on the word-initial 'se' piece of split words (se|borrhea, se|psis, se|pal, se|baceous, se|brene) and on 'div' in div|inity; pushes toward 'curve'.

L27n2555.name: Capitalized piece, get
L27n2555.description: Strongly negative on a capitalized word start or name piece, esp. 'Pad' in Pad|ua and Pad|ucah, and 'W' in W|ool, W|et, W|iringPi; pushes toward 'get'.

L27n217.name: 'str' cluster start, created
L27n217.description: Fires on a word-opening 'str', 'st', 'sw', 'spr' or 'thr' piece cut from its word (str|olled, str|addling, sw|athed, spr|ang, thr|ong; also ref|ueling); pushes toward 'created' and 'formed'.

L27n2716.name: Consonant-cluster start, server
L27n2716.description: Fires on a short opening consonant cluster split from its word (cl|ots, g|ingersnap, g|rafted, qu|illwort, gu|illotine, spr|outs); pushes toward 'server' and 'client'.

L27n1379.name: 'im' word start, move
L27n1379.description: Strongly negative on the opening 'im', 'imm', 'omn' or 'em' piece of a split word (imm|unities, im|bedded, omn|ichannel, em|igrated, im|maculate); pushes toward 'move' and 'moving'.

L27n2772.name: Split name piece, goal
L27n2772.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split name or word (Des|ierto, Dol|aucothi, Bour|ges, Fil|adelfia, Se|ville, cope|ptide, uel|ph); pushes toward 'goal'.

L27n2526.name: 'bl/br' word start, smart
L27n2526.description: Fires on the opening piece of words split after bl, bre, bra, ble, wh, sh or p (bl|anch, bre|aching, bra|ai, ble|aching, wh|olly, sh|aking); pushes toward 'smart'.

L27n220.name: Hyphen in ranges
L27n220.description: Strongly negative on hyphens and punctuation joining numbers or compound parts (2<<->>3%, 6<<->>8 inches, student<<->>athletes, disulfide<<->>bridged) and on '(' before units; pushes toward odd fragments like ascal and erval.

L27n532.name: Name start, Chinese comma
L27n532.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or foreign split word (D|harma, Dal|mau, Mu|hammad, Be|cciu, Di|aptomus, Mes|quita); pushes toward full-width punctuation like '，' and '：'.

L27n897.name: Mid-name subword fragments
L27n897.description: A middle piece of a word split into 3+ tokens, mostly foreign or Romance names (Arn|ol|fo, Filad|elf|ia, Star|ce|vo, Al|fon|so, Gyn|oecium); pushes toward '-io' endings.

L27n1028.name: Health-text modifiers
L27n1028.description: The word just before the head noun it modifies in health or instruction prose ('intr' in intravenous, 'chronic' fatigue, 'regular' exercise, 'financial' protection, 'with' rest); pushes toward role nouns like scientist, doctor, logger.

L27n767.name: Word-internal '-al' fragments
L27n767.description: A non-initial piece of a longer word that continues with '-al' or '-als' (exh|ale, glott|al, mamm|al, Mugh|al, surre|al, jack|als, nost|algia); pushes toward 'al'/'AL' tokens.

L27n1436.name: Mixed technical term pieces
L27n1436.description: Tokens inside technical or UI terms: 'Ω' after a resistance value (200 Ω), 'electrom' in electromagnetism, 'Non' in nonproliferation, 'user' and 'mouse' or 'finger' in interaction lists; pushes toward 'inter' (interaction) tokens.

L27n2130.name: 'mis-' prefix and fragments
L27n2130.description: The 'mis' onset of mis-words (misfits, mischievous, misshapen, mischance) and other mid-word fragments of split names (Par|akeet, Esp|asianus); pushes toward 'ident'/'identity' tokens.

L27n1800.name: First pieces of names
L27n1800.description: The first subword piece of a split capitalised name, mostly places or people (Beth|any, Dh|ala, N|akhon, Rom|mel, Hol|man, Hum|mingbird, Kn|idos); pushes toward 'update' tokens.

L27n829.name: Technical term openers
L27n829.description: The first piece of a technical or multi-token term or number, often right after a list or instruction marker (syll|ables, orig|ination, Ar|buscular, S3, verb in subject-verb, leading digit of 8611 m); pushes toward 'values' and 'numbers'.

L27n1883.name: Word-initial M onsets
L27n1883.description: The 'm' or 'M' first letter or piece of a word or name, e.g. 'M' in Mennonite, 'm' in brood mares, 'Mon' in Monet, 'm' in mowers; pushes toward 'Ma'/'ma' tokens.

L27n1385.name: Piece before an '-op'
L27n1385.description: The piece just before an 'op' ending in a split word (slo|ping, sto|op, Aes|op, countert|op, isot|opes, the SS in TSOP); pushes toward 'op' tokens.

L27n2171.name: Word-initial R onsets
L27n2171.description: A lone 'R' or 'r' that starts a word or hyphen piece (Rake, rangers, rationally, Rethink, Ramsay, Shah Rukh), and '-int' in low- or high-intensity; pushes toward 'rate' tokens.

L27n1884.name: Word-initial P onsets
L27n1884.description: The 'p' or 'P' first letter or piece of a word or name, often a single-letter token (P|olar, p|enguin, p|ungent, P|acific, p|atty); pushes toward 'pop' and 'population' tokens.

L27n444.name: Mid-word fragments, quote out
L27n444.description: A non-initial piece of a long Latin, scientific or foreign word (Phry|nosoma 'ry', Thelypter|idaceae 'ely', Phil|harmonic 'har', C|uen|ca 'uen'); pushes toward closing quote and ) tokens.

L27n1048.name: IPA and foreign glyphs
L27n1048.description: A non-ASCII or special glyph such as IPA symbols (ə, ˈ, ɪ, ʲ), accents (´), Devanagari or Thai letters, and ❶, often inside a pronunciation guide or after a name; pushes toward HTML entity starts '&#' and '&nbsp'.

L27n1277.name: Name-start fragments, brackets
L27n1277.description: The first piece of a split proper name or taxon (Gle|icheniaceae, Sel|aginellaceae, Salv|iniaceae, Gu|imarães, Br|unsbüttel) or word (f|ables, str|angle-weed), right before its continuation; pushes toward closing brackets and quotes like ) and 」.

L27n2723.name: L and Bel onsets
L27n2723.description: The 'L' or 'l' onset, or a 'Bel', 'Bl' or 'Bal' piece, that starts a capitalised word or name (L|auterpacht, l|izards, Bel|oved, Bl|anche, Bel|grave, L|avinia); pushes toward 'adjacent' and 'neighbor' tokens.

L27n1204.name: Name fragments, mixed
L27n1204.description: A capitalised word or name piece that the next token completes (De|indl, Mel|vin, Az|aleas, Pont|ifical, H|aversine, hal|ibut), and 'de' in 'de Gaulle'; pushes toward 'gr'/'Gr' tokens.

L27n1816.name: Lone P/V/h onsets
L27n1816.description: A lone 'P', 'V' or 'h' starting an acronym or term (PESCO, VFDs, PDD-NOS, Vortex, hilly, hatching), or a piece before the end of a word; pushes toward 'component' tokens.
L27n1816.name_orig: Lone P, V or h onsets

L27n1538.name: 'v' in virus words
L27n1538.description: The 'v' piece inside virus, vaccine and vector words (retro|v|irus, anti-retro|v|iral, the 'v' of 'vaccine'), and 'distance' before '-vector' or 'oss' in Cossack; pushes toward 'vector' and 'vec' tokens.

L27n2342.name: Place-name early pieces
L27n2342.description: The first or early piece of a split proper name, mostly places (Khal|ifa, Bal|ochistan, Cal|le Joaquin, Se|ville, Ikht|iyar); pushes toward 'drop' and 'drops' tokens.

L27n2259.name: Split word first pieces
L27n2259.description: The first piece of a longer word split into tokens (thr|ived, thr|usters, Comp|ounds, pract|ising, juris|prudence, discrim|inated, suff|used, terr|aced); pushes toward 'len' tokens.

L27n1302.name: Split-word middle pieces
L27n1302.description: Fires on a middle piece of a word split into 3+ tokens, such as 'ish' in Tr-ish-a, 'art' in Ag-art-ala, or 'ant' in EU-ant-itrust; pushes toward capital 'ST'/'AT'/'ET' tokens.

L27n918.name: Rare-word incomplete fragments
L27n918.description: Fires on non-final pieces of rare or technical words split across tokens, such as 'ac' in halicacabum, 'ic' in penicillins, and 'orp' in scorpions; pushes toward 'inf', 'inc', 'inv' word starts.

L27n3031.name: Word-initial Se/Sp fragment
L27n3031.description: Fires on the 'Se', 'Sp', or 'se' token that opens a word split into pieces (Sp|ence, se|borrhea, se|psis, Se|ville); pushes toward 'expand' and 'expansion'.

L27n782.name: Capital name-start letters
L27n782.description: Fires on the first capital-letter piece of a name or title, often the first piece of a word split in two (Po|op, Y|uen, B|ering, Sh|intoism); pushes toward single capitals like A, E, C.

L27n1183.name: Greek-Latin science word pieces
L27n1183.description: Fires on a middle piece of long Greek or Latin science words split into tokens (ut in neutrophils, os in angiosperms, athe in Cyatheaceae); pushes toward 'ph' pieces.

L27n1862.name: Word-start p fragments
L27n1862.description: Fires on the 'p' or 'P' token that opens a word fragment (P|olar, P|uma, p|atted, P|omeranian, P|OPs); pushes toward 'pack' and 'package' tokens.

L27n422.name: Dermis-style word middles
L27n422.description: Fires on middle pieces of long words split into tokens, most often 'der', 'ider', and 'mis' in dermis and epidermis, and 'nos' in gymnosperms; pushes toward word-final 'm' and 'ms' pieces.

L27n3004.name: Name-start Ch/Ph fragments
L27n3004.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into pieces, especially 'Ch', 'Ph', 'Cor', and 'Sh' (Ch|iles, Ph|atthalung, Cor|al); pushes toward 'connection' tokens.

L27n1262.name: Diffuse mid-phrase fragments
L27n1262.description: Diffuse: fires on mid-phrase pieces such as 'food' in 'food security', 'Gradient' in 'Extreme Gradient boosting', and 'nond' in nondiscriminatory; pushes weakly toward 'des' tokens.

L27n2133.name: Name continuation fragments
L27n2133.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a name split into tokens (Char|lem|agne, P|ö|yry, Daw|es, Mes|ozoic, Fo|xx); pushes toward 'format' tokens.

L27n1625.name: Piece before v-fragment
L27n1625.description: Fires on the piece just before a split-off 'v' or 'va' fragment (chie|vous, retrie|vers, lar|val, cre|vasse, bre|vitomentosus); pushes toward 'v', 'va', and 'val' tokens.

L27n1243.name: Wet and marsh words
L27n1243.description: Fires on 'wet' in wetlands and 'marsh' in marshlands, and weakly on 'freshwater' and 'lush'; pushes toward the 'me' token.

L27n2295.name: C/con word-start fragments
L27n2295.description: Fires on short first pieces of longer words that begin with c, con, or oc (oc|arbon, con|fluence, CON|sciousness, cam|otes); pushes toward 'Cons' and 'consistent' tokens.

L27n2469.name: Short word-start pieces
L27n2469.description: Fires on a short first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'w' in w|ondrous, 'fer' in fer|ocious, and 'gu' in gu|illotine; pushes toward 'coin' and 'money' tokens.

L27n576.name: Foreign name fragments
L27n576.description: Fires on the first piece of a transliterated foreign name, mostly Chinese, Indic, or Japanese (Beng|a, Jing, Ming, Nagara); pushes toward 'ak' and language names like Japanese and Korean.

L27n822.name: Diffuse word-start fragments
L27n822.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer words, such as co|exist, st|aves, pre|-exposure, and refr|active; pushes toward 'ex' and 'Ex' tokens.

L27n1251.name: 'in' after get; spell-check
L27n1251.description: Fires on 'in' in phrasal verbs like 'get in shape' and 'stay in place', and on 'spell' before 'checker'; pushes toward 'check' tokens.

L27n1904.name: Th/wh digraph word-starts
L27n1904.description: Fires on the 'Th', 'wh', 'rh', or 'eth' onset of a word split into pieces (Th|espians, th|yme, wh|izz, rh|izomes); pushes toward 'player' tokens.

L27n3026.name: Consonant-cluster word-starts
L27n3026.description: Fires on consonant-cluster word starts such as 'bl', 'str', 'kr', 'Cl', and 'Wh' (bl|urring, str|addles, kr|ill, Cl|ifton); pushes toward 'stop' and 'stops' tokens.

L27n458.name: Opening paren before acronym
L27n458.description: Fires on the opening '(' that starts a parenthetical acronym, such as (SCI), (AIDS), (HIV), or (MDA), and on capital pieces inside acronyms; pushes toward capital 'S' starts.

L27n2157.name: Split-word fragments
L27n2157.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a rare word split into tokens, such as 'omn|isc|ient', 'Kh|adur', 'benef|actor', 'Inf|initives' and 'fr|acting'; pushes 'active/Active'.

L27n3018.name: Rare-word first pieces
L27n3018.description: Fires on the first or early piece of a rare or proper-noun word split into tokens, such as 'Ant|ial', 'neo|classical', 'ench|il|ada', 'Rab|as', 'Coll|atine' and 'flash|cards'; pushes 'class/classical'.

L27n410.name: Verb stems before -ing
L27n410.description: Fires on the verb-stem piece of a word split before an -ing or participle ending, such as 'f|loss|ing', 'pl|owing', 'h|atching', 'St|aying', 'rem|aking' and 'substit|uting'; pushes gerunds like 'making/creating'.

L27n1172.name: Place-name fragments
L27n1172.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized place or thing name split into tokens, such as 'T|oulouse', 'Or|iskany', 'cre|vasse', 'lo|cket' and 'cr|annog'; pushes 'station/facilities'.

L27n346.name: Rare-word middle pieces
L27n346.description: Goes negative on an inner piece of a rare, foreign or misspelled word split into several tokens, such as 'cantal|ou|pe', 'mar|ipa', 'Gar|tr|ap' and 'phil|adel|phus'; pushes word-start 'pr/pi/pl/py' pieces.

L27n512.name: Open paren before acronym
L27n512.description: Goes negative on the '(' that opens a parenthetical right after a name, usually an acronym, such as 'Security Agency (CISA)' or 'Dry Eye Syndrome (DES)'; pushes short fragments like 'se', 'que', 'co'.

L27n1315.name: Inner pieces of names
L27n1315.description: Goes negative on a middle sub-token of a split surname or foreign proper name, such as 'Kh|ulaifi', 'Ef|remov', 'Radc|huk' and 'Sp|ang', where the name is still continuing; pushes '@' tokens.

L27n1908.name: Lone 'd' word-start
L27n1908.description: Fires on a lone 'd' or 'D' that begins a word piece, often after a hyphen or at a split word start, such as 'Und|eclared', 'd|umb', 'D|ialysis', 'flower-d|otted' and 'anti-d|rying'; pushes 'die/death'.

L27n2396.name: Long-word prefix pieces
L27n2396.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a long word split into subtokens, mostly prefixes such as 'intr|avenous', 'ultr|aviolet', 'aqu|aculture', 'meg|aphone' and 'pharmac|...'; pushes capital 'A' tokens like 'AD', 'AP' and 'asap'.

L27n2057.name: Predicate-opening verb or modal
L27n2057.description: Goes negative on the first word of a predicate right after its subject, such as 'we <<can>> talk', 'people <<took>> place', 'it is <<our>> job' and 'to <<take>> steps', mostly modals and 'take/took'; pushes 'turn/turns'.

L27n1571.name: Lone 'D' word-start
L27n1571.description: Goes negative on a lone 'D' or 'd', or an 'St' start, that begins a word piece, such as 'Semi-d|warf', 'd|ocking', 'D|harma', 'nond|iscriminatory' and 'St|ewardship'; pushes 'double/dual'.

L27n115.name: Determiner before problem nouns
L27n115.description: Goes negative on the word that introduces a problem noun phrase, mainly 'these' after address/combat/identify ('address these issues'), 'of' after 'importance', and 'take' in 'take steps'; pushes code identifiers like 'ParameterValue'.

L27n2761.name: 'st' after hyphen
L27n2761.description: Fires on 'st' or 'St' starting a word piece, often right after a hyphen ('pre-|st|ressed', 'non-|st|ick', 'post-|st|orm') or as a split word start ('St|abilizes'); pushes 'birth/born/baby'.

L27n947.name: Capitalized name fragments
L27n947.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalized name split into tokens, such as 'Fr|anks', 'Fr|isia', 'McM|urray', 'Hojib|lanca' and 'Pr|iscus'; pushes commas.

L27n1201.name: Modifier opening noun phrase
L27n1201.description: Fires on the article or first modifier that opens a noun phrase in an instruction or prepositional phrase, such as 'to <<a>> saucepan', 'with <<a>> bronze', 'electric griddle', 'plain hair clip' and 'accom|panied'; pushes nationality and style adjectives like 'Chinese/Japanese'.

L27n1999.name: Split word first piece
L27n1999.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word split into two tokens, such as 'my|corrhizae', 'Ath|lete', 'out|grow', 'mis|fits' and 'Mal|agasy'; pushes 'think/idea/thought'.

L27n1585.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1585.description: Fires on an uppercase piece in the middle of an all-caps word or acronym, from the second piece on, such as 'SO' in 'SOA', 'NO' in 'CARTE|NOIRE', 'DO' in 'DOI', 'MO' in 'MOBI' and 'APPRO|ACH'; pushes 'pen/pers/plen' fragments.

L27n2444.name: Past-tense verb stems
L27n2444.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a past-tense or participle verb split into tokens, such as 'enc|roached', 'c|eded', 'reb|uked', 'spr|outed', 'w|aned' and 'anch|ised', with some name pieces mixed in; pushes 'found/Found'.

L27n1263.name: Medical-term word pieces
L27n1263.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a rare medical or technical word split into tokens, such as 'br|uxism', 'append|icit|is', 'cen|tigr|ade' and 'qu|asar'; pushes 'process/processes'.

L27n853.name: Acronym first letters
L27n853.description: Goes negative on the first letter of an acronym or institution name in a proper-noun slot, such as 'A' in 'Texas A&M', 'E' in 'EPA', 'C' in 'CBO', 'H' in 'HIT' and 'A' in 'AWWA'; pushes 'team/teams'.

L27n709.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n709.description: Fires (goes negative) on the newline right after a user message's <|im_end|>, just before the assistant turn; weaker on mid-word fragments like 'az' and 'kn' in web text. Pushes output toward a bare 'a' token, which the steered run repeats as 'aa(aa('.

L27n1357.name: Mid-word 'c' fragment
L27n1357.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'oc' piece split inside a longer word or hyphenated compound, just before the word continues (anti-|cancer, radi-oc|arbon, E-c|igs, mening-oc|occal); pushes output toward 'col' tokens.

L27n2495.name: Proper-noun first piece
L27n2495.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first or second subword piece of a capitalised proper name (Tisha in Tisha B'Av, Ulysses, Oshkosh, Blasco, Kapiri, Archaeology), mainly where a name's spelling is split; pushes output toward 'Muslim' and 'Islamic' tokens.

L27n2195.name: 'War' in 'World War'
L27n2195.description: Fires on 'War' right after 'World' in 'World War II', plus other word-start pieces in history and science text (Sax in Saxony, min in minstrel, gl in glomerular); pushes output toward 'crime' and 'criminal' tokens.

L27n525.name: Piece after name joint
L27n525.description: Fires (goes negative) on the piece right after a joint in a split name or hyphenated compound (iddles in Middlesbrough, '-' in self-organise and Phos-Flur, 'l' in Abdu'l-Bahá, '/s' in /etc/sudoers); pushes output toward 're' and 'res' tokens.

L27n1662.name: Mid-word 'c' or 'ex'
L27n1662.description: Fires on a short 'c', 'oc', 'ex' or 'photoc' piece inside a split word, right before the word continues (single-c|elled, exc|elled, Ex|eter, ex|otic, nematoc|ysts, photoc|atalytic); pushes output toward 'cell' and 'cells'.

L27n2899.name: Single 'g' word-start piece
L27n2899.description: Fires (goes negative) on a lone 'g' or 'G' piece that begins a word or follows a hyphen (-g in fully-grown, G in Guelph, g in gorges, gilded, gout, Gait), plus 'og' in aminoglycoside and 'ah' in docosahexaenoic; pushes output toward 'balance' and 'balanced' tokens.

L27n2071.name: Word-start 'b' piece
L27n2071.description: Fires on a 'b' or 'B' piece that starts a word part or follows a hyphen (fire-b|ombing, -b|attle, Nes-b|itt, Bab|ylon, Sothe-b|ys, eye-b|row); pushes output toward 'bin' and 'binary' tokens.

L27n475.name: Capital 'G'/'g' start
L27n475.description: Fires (goes negative) on a capital or lowercase 'G'/'g' that starts a name or word (G-d, G-ospels, Garter, Gansu, gloomy, gauze, gangs), weaker on 'R' in Rama; pushes output toward '---', '***' and '____' separator tokens.

L27n1407.name: Split-word fragment before suffix
L27n1407.description: Fires (goes negative) on a fragment cut mid-word or mid-name just before its continuation (Ever|lasting, Ever|est, gl|ings, Yudh|oy|ono, Z|ULU, Scott), strongest on 'Ever' and 'gl'; pushes output toward 'ing' and 'ng' tokens, which the steered run repeats as 'Inging...'.

L27n536.name: Proper-noun start, country write
L27n536.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first piece of a capitalised proper noun or acronym (UN in UNICEF, Tel in Tel Aviv, Uppsala, Ret in Golden Retriever, HIV, NFPA, CDC); pushes output toward country names like China, India and Italy.

L27n2138.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n2138.description: Fires (goes negative) on the first piece of a word that opens with a consonant cluster, usually when split (sc|oliosis, sc|arring, Stan|wick, str|icken, sn|ags, infl|ow); pushes output toward 'collect' and 'collection'.

L27n1200.name: Hyphen-joined 'c' or 'Sh'
L27n1200.description: Fires (goes negative) on the piece after a hyphen or on a split-word start, most strongly on 'c' after 'non-' or 'post-' (non-c|ancerous, post-c|ivil, terra-c|otta), and on 'ib' in Drell and 'Sh' in Shunga; pushes output toward 'files' tokens.

L27n254.name: Foreign diacritic letters
L27n254.description: Fires (goes negative) on non-English letters with diacritics or IPA and Sanskrit marks (ˈ, ś, ṭ, ḥ, ʾ, č, ə) inside foreign names and transliterations; pushes output toward accented foreign word endings like 'äre', 'è', 'é' and 'ä'.

L27n1609.name: Split names and numbers
L27n1609.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of long names (Char|lemagne, Mai|monides, Perna can|aliculus, germ) and on the tail pieces of split numbers (7,00|0, 163,00|0, 40 million); pushes output toward 'strong' and 'strength'.

L27n2198.name: Place-name first word
L27n2198.description: Fires on the first token of a multi-word proper name, mostly 'Santa' and 'Saint'/'St' (Santa Rosa, Saint George), plus 'Cl' in Clifton and 'Ch' in Chaco; pushes output toward 'sent' and 'send' tokens.

L27n2569.name: Split proper-noun middle piece
L27n2569.description: Fires (goes negative) on a piece of a multi-token proper name that is not its first piece (Ath|abasca, Hal|icarnassus, Stal|ingrad, Per|iander, Ver|ne), plus 'exh' and 'ex' fragments in exhorted and exhaling; pushes output toward 'scenario' and 'situation'.

L27n2498.name: Word-start 'h' or 'st'
L27n2498.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting with 'h', 'st', 'br' or 'tr' when the word is split or follows a hyphen (Hit|tite, H|ellenic, st|ings, br|uxism, hon|ours, self-h|arming, tre|acherous); pushes output toward 'wear', 'clothing' and 'fashion'.

L27n1910.name: 'str' word onset
L27n1910.description: Fires (goes negative) on the 'str' piece that opens a word, usually its first subword (str|aits, str|angle, str|ung, Str|onsay), and weakly on 'atro' in paratroops; pushes output toward 'area' tokens.

L27n2604.name: Post-hyphen word piece
L27n2604.description: Fires on the word piece right after a hyphen or the 'un' prefix inside a compound or split word (specially-|abled, beta-|carotene, flying-|saucer, un|suited, anti-|shear); pushes output toward 'sk' and 'skin' tokens.

L27n2707.name: Mid-word fragments (gold)
L27n2707.description: Strongly negative on a piece inside a word or name that is still being spelled out, e.g. 'ic' in apricots, 'ec' in Dogecoin, 'et' in whetstone, 'pot' in potash; weaker on mining and coin words. Pushes toward 'gold' and 'metal'.

L27n1241.name: Short word-start fragments
L27n1241.description: Strongly negative on the short 1-3 letter opening piece of a word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'Se' in Seville, 'sa' in sautéed, 'Be' in Beccaria, 'Res' in resettlement, 'Ful' in fulminata. Pushes toward 'defendant' and 'plaintiff'.

L27n272.name: Split-word middles (G tokens)
L27n272.description: Strongly negative on a piece in the middle of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'bul' in bulges, 'arr' in arranging, 'besie' in besieged, 'sur' in surges, 'OM' in OMG, 'brid' in unbridled. Pushes toward 'G' gene-like tokens such as GA, GC and GP.

L27n2925.name: Opening fragments of names
L27n2925.description: Strongly negative on the first 1-3 letters of a capitalized word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'Le' in Leibniz, 'Ps' in Psophodes, 'Pl' in Plague, 'Lo' in Lo-, 'tro' in trophic. Pushes toward 'guess' and 'unknown'.

L27n2947.name: Initial F and Ph
L27n2947.description: Strongly negative on the letter F (and Ph or ph) opening a word or name, e.g. 'F' in Fossil, Ferrets, Ferry, Falmouth, Focusing, Fauvism; also 'ph' in phagocytes. Pushes toward 'filter'.

L27n2276.name: Mid-word fragments (visit)
L27n2276.description: Strongly negative on a piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'micro' in a microbial term, '-r' in rhizobium, 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'b' in Middlesbrough, 'ons' in Wonsan, 'Ex' in Exile. Pushes toward 'visit' tokens.

L27n2132.name: Initial enc and c
L27n2132.description: Strongly negative on 'enc', 'ac' or a lone 'c' that begins a word split into tokens, e.g. encroached, enclosures, Acadian, acquires, plus '-c' in crust and '-C' in COVID. Pushes toward 'cl' tokens.

L27n2250.name: Split-word starts, chat newlines
L27n2250.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'hyp' in hypodermis, 'Tr' in Trang, 'sh' in shunt; also on the newline that closes a user turn in chat prompts. Pushes toward ')' and quote-closing punctuation.

L27n784.name: Proper-name continuations
L27n784.description: Strongly positive on a middle or late piece of a place or person name split into tokens, e.g. 't' in Get-t-ysburg, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Carm' in Carmarthen, 'Ash' in Ash'ari. Pushes toward surnames such as Smith, Jones, Miller and Taylor.

L27n2401.name: Unfinished word-start pieces
L27n2401.description: Strongly negative on the piece right after a word's first letters while the word is still unfinished, e.g. 'f' in feta and fritters, 'athy' in hypoparathyroidism, 'Ish' in Ishiguro, 'alth' in Waltham, 'infl' in inflamed. Pushes toward 'union'.

L27n1279.name: Creative-work titles and prompts
L27n1279.description: Strongly positive on the opening quote or first word of a creative work's title, e.g. 'Water' in Water Lilies or 'Happy' in a song credit, and on request words in creative-writing prompts such as 'Write a short story' or 'song with lyrics'. Pushes toward 'artist' and 'music'.

L27n1561.name: Name-start fragments
L27n1561.description: Strongly negative on the first 1-3 letters of a place, person or word split into tokens, e.g. 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Par' in Paraguay, 'Tr' in Trivium or Tractor, 'Ca' in Caernarvon, 'Ar' in Aragon. Pushes toward 'automatic'.

L27n2424.name: Word-start fragments (record)
L27n2424.description: Strongly negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'cultiv' in cultivars, 'contr' in contrived, 'def' in defecate, 'Tam' in tampons, 'ot' in otoscope, 'trav' in travails. Pushes toward 'record'.

L27n286.name: Word-start fragments (comma)
L27n286.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'Qu' in quinoa, 'Sus' in Susilo, 'Pi' in Piñera, 'Neg' in neglected, 'auc' in Chaucer, 'vers' in conversely. Pushes toward comma and quote-comma tokens.

L27n2011.name: Long-word opening syllables
L27n2011.description: Strongly negative on the opening syllable of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'las' in lasagna, 'synt' in syntactic, 'Moh' in Mohenjo-daro, 'sw' in swimmers, 'gluc' in glucocorticoids, 'og' in aminoglycoside. Pushes toward 'tag'.

L27n2883.name: Name-middle fragments
L27n2883.description: Strongly negative on a piece inside a place, person or organisation name split into tokens, e.g. 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Kr' in Krabi, 'Bak' in Bakunin, 'Ki' in Ki-moon, 'ug' in Chugoku, 'Dev' in Devonta. Pushes toward 'reward' and 'awards'.

L27n361.name: Rare-name fragments
L27n361.description: Strongly positive on a piece of a rare or foreign name split into tokens, e.g. 'uh' in a Congolese girl's name, 'ry' in Phrynosoma, 'Bh' in Bhagabhadra, 'hr' in Fakhrullin, 'Ram' in Ramihantaniarivo. Pushes toward sentence-end punctuation.

L27n334.name: Name before open paren
L27n334.description: Strongly negative on a function, variable or symbol name right before its argument list or an '=' sign, in code and maths: 'rhs' in rhs(t,y), 'h' in h(x), 'cot' in cot x, 'log' in log(length), 'R' in R(t). Pushes toward '(' followed by a noun, e.g. '(segment' or '(signal'.

L27n1026.name: Start of split words
L27n1026.description: Strongly negative on the first piece of a word or acronym split into tokens, e.g. 'DF' in DFID, 'UN' in UNDP, 'ta' in curtailed, 'contr' in contraptions, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'Ant' in Antonov, 'sap' in sapodilla. Pushes toward 'id' tokens.

L27n899.name: Word-initial capital R
L27n899.description: Strongly positive on a word-initial capital 'R' (or lowercase 'r') at the start of a word, e.g. Rickets, R&D, Rational, Routines, RADIATION, 'r' in ripples and rationally. Pushes toward '&' tokens.
